why_this_file_exists: The 14 thin-map proposals in THIN-MAP-PROPOSALS-AIMSF.md were put to the director and ruled one task at a time. This file holds those rulings so the write and the ruling cannot drift apart: scripts/promote-thin-maps-93.mjs refuses to promote any clause this file does not list, and refuses to run at all if a task's promote and decline lists overlap.
rules: `promote` is the exact set that may move to PRIMARY. A clause absent from it is refused by the promote script, whatever a proposal document says.
`decline` records what was proposed and NOT approved, with the reason. A declined clause left unrecorded reads as an oversight next time somebody re-proposes it.
`boundary_check_first` names a clause the boundary rule holds back. The promote script refuses it until the check has run and the passage is under the 60-word trigger or cleared by name.
Every clause here is 42001 unless `source_id` says otherwise.
